articles.title: Alibaba Open Sources OpenCodeReview for AI-Assisted Code Review
articles.author: Renato Losio
articles.summary: Alibaba recently open-sourced OpenCodeReview, an AI-powered code review CLI that combines deterministic pipelines for file selection, bundling, and rule matching with an LLM agent for dynamic code analysis. It supports built-in checks for issues such as null-pointer exceptions, thread safety, XSS, and SQL injection. By Renato Losio
